highlights: Compatible Devices    Mac Mini M4, Mac Mini M4 Pro

8TB Storage Expansion: Upgrade your Mac Mini M4 with up to 8TB internal storage using the Mac Mini M4 Dock. Supports M.2 NVMe SSDs (2230/2242/2260/2280) for blazing 10Gbps speeds. Note: The SSD, charger, and charging cable are not included.

11-in-1 Connectivity: The Mac Mini M4 Dock includes all the ports you need for fast and seamless connections, a 10Gbps NVMe SSD enclosure, 3x 10Gbps USB-A data ports, 2x 5 Gbps USB-A data ports, 2x 10Gbps USB-C data ports, SD/TF card reader, and 5V USB-C power supply port (recommended for multi-device setups).

SD/TF Card Slots: The Mac Mini M4 Hub features microSD and SD card readers on the front of the device for easy access. Both ports offer 104MB/s for rapid media access and can be used at the same time.
